verdict.rationale: Postman's Fabric Gateway docs describe registering an MCP server and making it available to a team, and Agent Mode lets users act via natural language across the API lifecycle, suggesting some capacity to consume external MCP tools. However, most other MCP-related evidence (MCP Generator, official Postman MCP server) is about Postman exposing itself as an MCP server rather than consuming third-party servers, and there's no hands-on confirmation that arbitrary external MCP servers can be plugged in and used as tools.
